WITH transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitNumber,
    visitStartTime,
    device.deviceCategory,
    h.transaction.transactionId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_transaction_date,
    MIN(visitStartTime) as first_transaction_time
  FROM transactions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction_session AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.deviceCategory
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN first_transaction ft 
    ON t.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId 
    AND t.date = ft.first_transaction_date
    AND t.visitStartTime = ft.first_transaction_time
)
SELECT 
  ft.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  fts.deviceCategory
FROM first_transaction ft
JOIN first_visit fv ON ft.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
JOIN first_transaction_session fts ON ft.fullVisitorId = fts.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

WITH home_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.time,
    h.page.pagePath as homePagePath,
    LEAD(h.page.pagePath) OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) as nextPagePath,
    LEAD(h.time) OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) - h.time as timeOnHome
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
    AND h.type = 'PAGE'
    AND h.page.pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_pages AS (
  SELECT nextPagePath
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE nextPagePath IS NOT NULL
),
max_page AS (
  SELECT nextPagePath as mostCommonNextPage
  FROM next_pages
  GROUP BY nextPagePath
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(SAFE_CAST(timeOnHome / 1000 AS INT64)) as maxTimeSeconds
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE timeOnHome IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT mostCommonNextPage FROM max_page) as mostCommonNextPage,
  (SELECT maxTimeSeconds FROM max_time) as maxTimeSeconds

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)) AS month,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3'), COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2')) * 100 AS add_to_cart_conversion_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'), COUNTIF(h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2')) * 100 AS purchase_conversion_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type IN ('2', '3', '6')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH first_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitStartTime,
    totals.timeOnSite
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND visitNumber = 1
),
purchase_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE totals.transactions > 0
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fv.fullVisitorId
  FROM first_visits fv
  WHERE fv.timeOnSite > 300
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM purchase_sessions ps 
      WHERE ps.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId 
        AND ps.visitStartTime > fv.visitStartTime
    )
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualified) as qualified_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) FROM first_visits) as total_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualified), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) FROM first_visits)) * 100 as raw_percentage

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(total_discharges * average_total_payments) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC

  WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2008`
  WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL

  WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL

  UNION ALL

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`

  UNION ALL

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`

  SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2015`
  WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
),
daily_avg AS (
  SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude,
         AVG(wind_speed) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM all_years
  GROUP BY year, month, day, latitude, longitude
)
SELECT latitude, longitude, 
       CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', 
              LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', 
              LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING), 2, '0')) as date,
       ROUND(avg_wind_speed, 2) as avg_wind_speed,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_wind_speed DESC) as rn
FROM daily_avg
QUALIFY rn <= 5

SELECT

FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009`
WHERE stn = '723758'
  AND mo = '10'
  AND temp != 9999.9
ORDER BY temp DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT start_station_id, start_station_name, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018 AND starttime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY start_station_id, start_station_name
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id FROM station_counts
),
day_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM t.starttime) as day_of_week, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips` t, top_station s
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.starttime) = 2018 AND t.starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND t.start_station_id = s.start_station_id
  GROUP BY day_of_week
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
hour_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.starttime) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips` t, top_station s
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.starttime) = 2018 AND t.starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND t.start_station_id = s.start_station_id
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.day_of_week, h.hour_of_day
FROM day_counts d, hour_counts h

SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, MINUTE)),
    COUNT(*)
  ) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz ON t.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
WHERE t.data_file_month = 2
  AND t.data_file_year = 2016
  AND (t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-02-01 00:00:00') AND t.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-02-08 00:00:00'))
  AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
  AND t.passenger_count > 3
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10
  AND pz.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND dz.borough = 'Brooklyn'

WITH trip_distances AS (
  SELECT
    t.bike_number,
    6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((s_end.latitude - s_start.latitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2), 2) +
      COS(s_start.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(s_end.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) *
      POWER(SIN((s_end.longitude - s_start.longitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180 / 2), 2)
    )) AS trip_distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_start
    ON t.start_station_id = s_start.station_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_end
    ON t.end_station_id = s_end.station_id
)

SELECT
  bike_number,
  SUM(trip_distance_meters) AS total_distance_meters
FROM trip_distances
GROUP BY bike_number
ORDER BY bike_number

WITH monthly_data AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(end_date)) AS month_num,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 1000 AS total_minutes_thousands
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE DATE(end_date) >= '2017-01-01' AND DATE(end_date) < '2018-01-01'
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE 0 END) AS customer_minutes,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_data
  GROUP BY 1
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    am.month_num,
    COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0) AS customer_minutes,
    COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM all_months am
  LEFT JOIN pivoted p ON am.month_num = p.month_num
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  ROUND(ABS(customer_minutes - subscriber_minutes), 3) AS abs_diff_in_thousands
FROM joined
ORDER BY month_num

-- Compute the highest average speed for Berkeley trips > 1000m
WITH berkeley_stations AS (
  SELECT CAST(station_id AS INT64) as station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r ON CAST(s.region_id AS STRING) = CAST(r.region_id AS STRING)
  WHERE r.name = 'Berkeley'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_DISTANCE(t.start_station_geom, t.end_station_geom), t.duration_sec)), 1) as highest_avg_speed_mps
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
WHERE t.start_station_geom IS NOT NULL 
  AND t.end_station_geom IS NOT NULL
  AND t.start_station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM berkeley_stations)
  AND t.end_station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM berkeley_stations)
  AND ST_DISTANCE(t.start_station_geom, t.end_station_geom) > 1000

WITH age_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code, 
    country_name, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN population ELSE 0 END) AS pop_under_20, 
    SUM(population) AS total_pop 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific` 
  WHERE year = 2020 
  GROUP BY country_code, country_name
),
mid_pop AS (
  SELECT country_code, country_name, midyear_population 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` 
  WHERE year = 2020
)
SELECT 
  a.country_name,
  a.pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(a.pop_under_20, m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM age_pop a
JOIN mid_pop m ON a.country_code = m.country_code
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    country_region,
    date,
    CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) AS anxiety,
    CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) AS depression
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
  WHERE country_region = 'United States'
),
period1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2019, AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2019
  FROM filtered
  WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01'
),
period2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2020, AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2020
  FROM filtered
  WHERE date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  'United States' AS country,
  p1.avg_anxiety_2019,
  p1.avg_depression_2019,
  p2.avg_anxiety_2020,
  p2.avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2.avg_anxiety_2020 - p1.avg_anxiety_2019, p1.avg_anxiety_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_anxiety,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2.avg_depression_2020 - p1.avg_depression_2019, p1.avg_depression_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_depression
FROM period1 p1, period2 p2

WITH player_totals AS (
  SELECT team_market, player_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE period = 2
    AND points_scored > 0
    AND season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
  GROUP BY team_market, player_id
  HAVING SUM(points_scored) >= 15
),
market_counts AS (
  SELECT team_market, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as distinct_players
  FROM player_totals
  GROUP BY team_market
),
top5 AS (
  SELECT team_market
  FROM market_counts
  ORDER BY distinct_players DESC, team_market ASC
  LIMIT 5
),
tournament_games AS (
  SELECT season, round, days_from_epoch, game_date, day,
         win_seed, win_region, win_market, win_name, win_alias, win_team_id,
         win_school_ncaa, win_code_ncaa, win_kaggle_team_id, win_pts,
         lose_seed, lose_region, lose_market, lose_name, lose_alias, lose_team_id,
         lose_school_ncaa, lose_code_ncaa, lose_kaggle_team_id, lose_pts, num_ot, academic_year
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
    AND (win_market IN (SELECT team_market FROM top5)
         OR lose_market IN (SELECT team_market FROM top5))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_games

WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT state_code, MAX(evaluation_group_sequence_number) as latest_seq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY state_code
),
filtered_pop AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest_eval l ON p.state_code = l.state_code AND p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = l.latest_seq
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.state_code,
    p.evaluation_group,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      ELSE 1.0
    END as adj_factor,
    p.expansion_factor,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      ELSE 1.0
    END as acres
  FROM filtered_pop p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND reserved_status_code = 0 AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as timberland_acres,
    SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as forestland_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
timberland_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
),
forestland_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 'timberland' as category, 
       CAST(t.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, 
       t.evaluation_group,
       sn.state_code_name as state_name,
       t.timberland_acres as total_acres
FROM timberland_ranked t
JOIN state_names sn ON t.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE t.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forestland' as category, 
       CAST(f.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, 
       f.evaluation_group,
       sn.state_code_name as state_name,
       f.forestland_acres as total_acres
FROM forestland_ranked f
JOIN state_names sn ON f.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE f.rn = 1

WITH plot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_code,
    c.inventory_year,
    CASE WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN 'subplot' ELSE 'macroplot' END AS plot_type,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      ELSE 0
    END AS plot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)

-- Full query: get top 10 users by combined view counts
WITH 
-- Get question owners
question_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    owner_user_id AS user_id,
    id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
),

-- Get accepted answerers
accepted_answerers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pa.id = pq.accepted_answer_id
),

-- Get answers with score > 5
high_score_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.score > 5
),

-- Get total score per question for the 20% rule
question_total_scores AS (
  SELECT
    parent_id AS question_id,
    SUM(score) AS total_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),

-- Get answers exceeding 20% of total score and score > 0
high_pct_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN question_total_scores qts ON pa.parent_id = qts.question_id
  WHERE pa.score > 0 
    AND CAST(pa.score AS FLOAT64) > 0.2 * CAST(qts.total_score AS FLOAT64)
),

-- Get top 3 highest-scoring answers per question
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    pa.score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.parent_id ORDER BY pa.score DESC, pa.id ASC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
),

top3_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_id,
    question_id
  FROM ranked_answers
  WHERE rn <= 3
),

-- Combine all associated user-question pairs
associated_users AS (
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM question_owners
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM accepted_answerers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM high_score_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM high_pct_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM top3_answers
),

-- Deduplicate (same user-question pair from multiple criteria)
distinct_associations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, question_id FROM associated_users
)

-- Join with questions to get view counts, aggregate by user
SELECT 
  da.user_id,
  u.display_name,
  SUM(pq.view_count) AS combined_view_count
FROM distinct_associations da
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON da.question_id = pq.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON da.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY da.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY combined_view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102` e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
),
with_segments AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS segments
  FROM page_views
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    segments,
    CASE 
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5 THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) - 1)], ''), r'\+')
            AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(3)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')
              OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(4)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)'))
          THEN 'PDP'
          WHEN NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(segments[OFFSET(3)], ''), r'\+')
            AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(segments[OFFSET(4)], ''), r'\+')
            AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(3)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')
              OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(4)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)'))
          THEN 'PLP'
          ELSE 'other'
        END
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS page_type
  FROM with_segments
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_page_views,
  SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PDP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pdp_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PLP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as plp_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'other' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as other_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PDP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as pdp_percentage
FROM classified

    AND event_name = 'app_remove'

),
user_status AS (

    i.user_pseudo_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN u.uninstall_timestamp IS NOT NULL 
        AND u.uninstall_timestamp <= i.install_timestamp + 604800000000

)

  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(qualifies), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM user_status
